newsitem.title: USA: Colombian oil output to top 800,000 bpd - minister.
newsitem.headline: Colombian oil output to top 800,000 bpd - minister.

text.p: Colombia's oil production will surpass 800,000 barrels per day by the end of the year, Mines and Energy Minister Rodrigo Villamizar said on Thursday.
"By the end of the year we are going to be above 800,000 bpd," Villamizar told Reuters.
He said prodcution had averaged 640,000 bpd over the past two years. Previous government forecasts had predictd it would reach 720,000 bpd.
"The Cusiano field is going to start pumping in about a month and by the end of the year we're going to be pumping about 550,000 from that alone. It's very big," he said.
Villamizar was in Miami to attend a conference on developing private energy in Colombia.
